lessons.text: Baseline: val_loss 0.1838 in 2719 steps at 11.48M params (exp 0)
Exp 1's cosine was inverted and exp 3's cosine was a no-op (missing math import); correct cosine decay is still untested (exp 1, 3, human review)
Widening DiT from 256 to 384 hidden dim regresses val_loss by ~1.5% in 2-min runs; fewer steps (1525 vs 2719) outweigh capacity (exp 2)
Exp 3's cosine decay was a no-op because math was not imported, so LR stayed constant; cosine decay remains untested (exp 3, human review)
